faq:
Q: Is Larkline a real company?
A: No. Larkline is a fictional company and every fact on this site is made up. It is a demo of an agent-ready business by Himanshu Surana.
Q: How much does Larkline cost?
A: Plans start at $19 a month. Solo is $19 a month for one user. Team is $49 a month for up to 50 seats.
Q: Does Larkline work with accounting tools?
A: Yes. Two accounting integrations ship today: Xero and QuickBooks Online.
Q: Is there a free trial?
A: Yes. 14 days on any plan, no card needed.
Q: Can an AI agent book a Larkline demo?
A: An agent can check services, open demo slots and policies through a read-only MCP server. It cannot book or pay. The buyer books by email.
